Justification: This paper is a scoping review article. Following the categorization flow, it is not a review focused on land use land cover (LULC) future prediction. Its primary objective is to synthesize existing literature on the ecological determinants (climate, habitat, seasonality) of *Lutzomyia* sand fly vectors. While it mentions land use change as a context for future vector distribution, its focus is on summarizing vector ecology, not on reviewing or conducting LULC prediction methodologies or models.
